about: DND-1902: what a repo's base tip must not CONTAIN for a merge onto it (ai/lib/gh-merge-guard.sh -> gmg_content_health, run by gh-athena on GitHub and, since DND-1941, by glab-athena on GitLab). Keyed by the lower-case project path: <owner>/<repo> on GitHub, the full <namespace>/<project> on GitLab (a nested group is part of the key), so github.com/CJPoll/gen_saas and gitlab.com/cjpoll/gen_saas read the same entry. A malformed key is an error, never 'no check'. unique_migration_dirs is an ERE matched against each directory path in the tip's tree; in every matching directory, no two files named <digits>_*.exs may share the digits (an Ecto migration version). A repo not listed declares no content check, and the merge says which key it looked up. The bar lives here, in custom, never in the repo whose merge it judges.
